frontmatter.sidebar_description: Create or update payment collection for an order.

blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `createOrUpdateOrderPaymentCollectionWorkflow`. It belongs to the `@medusajs/medusa/core-flows` package.

This workflow creates or updates payment collection for an order. It's used by other order-related workflows,
such as [createOrderPaymentCollectionWorkflow](/references/medusa-workflows/createOrderPaymentCollectionWorkflow) to update an order's payment collections based on changes made to the order.

You can use this workflow within your customizations or your own custom workflows, allowing you to wrap custom logic around
creating or updating payment collections for an order.
